summary.text: Chris Runion is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 35, representing parts of Augusta and Rockingham counties, and Bath and Highland counties, serving since 2020. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Finance, and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Chris Runion was born in Harrisonburg, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.

The profile says he earned a B.S. in accounting from Virginia Tech in 1980 and an M.B.A. from James Madison University in 1984, and lists his occupation as president and CEO of Eddie Edwards Signs, Inc.
The profile lists him as a former president of the Rotary Club of Harrisonburg, governor of Rotary District 7570 in 2016-17, and a former chairman of the Rockingham County Planning Commission.
